contracts.resolveSectors: Returns empty array [] when circuit sector metadata is unavailable, missing, or empty. Never guesses or fabricates equal thirds (1/3, 2/3). Rejects inverted sector ranges (startProgress >= endProgress). Returns normalized SectorDivision[] only when sourced boundaries are provided.
contracts.overlayLayers: Turn markers, DRS zones, speed traps, and sector division layers render ONLY when verified sourced metadata is present in circuit.overlays. Coordinates for overlays with progress are strictly mapped to the authentic GeoJSON track spline, rejecting floating/unverified coordinates. DRS zones never stroke the full circuit path when unmeasured.
contracts.driverPlacement: Driver positions strictly clamp progress to [0, 1] (NaN defaults to 0), synchronously evaluate coordinates on the authentic GeoJSON polyline spline (ensuring immediate SSR and static HTML rendering), and update with SVG getPointAtLength when mounted in the DOM.
contracts.missingCircuit: Unknown or unspecified circuit IDs render an explicit accessible unavailable status card (role="status"), never a silent fallback to Monza under another name.
contracts.provenance: Accurate source provenance (bacinger/f1-circuits, MIT license, commit revision) is preserved in SVG desc, screen-reader text, and optional provenance strip.

scenarios: Scenario 1: resolveSectors returns empty array [] for bundled Monza with unavailable sectors; no 1/3 or 2/3 splits
Scenario 2: resolveSectors returns 3 normalized SectorDivision items when sourced boundaries are provided
Scenario 3: Missing/unavailable overlays produce NO inferred DRS, turn, speed trap, or sector elements in rendered output; source provenance preserved
Scenario 4: Valid sourced overlays (turns T1/T2, DRS zones, speed traps, sector splits) are faithfully rendered when metadata is present
Scenario 5: clampProgress clamps negative, >1, NaN, and +/-Infinity to [0, 1]
Scenario 6: Unknown circuit ID renders accessible unavailable status, NOT Monza track path or Monza metadata
Scenario 7: Zero em-dashes (— or –) or NaN coordinates in rendered DOM
Scenario 8: calculateSplineLength and getPointAtProgress spline projection on authentic GeoJSON normalizedCoordinates
Scenario 9: Sourced turn markers and traps reject floating coordinates, anchoring to track spline
Scenario 10: DRS overlays render accurate stroke segments and NEVER stroke full track
Scenario 11: Driver dots render synchronously in static markup / SSR directly on spline
Scenario 12: resolveSectors rejects inverted or zero-length sector ranges
